card.summary: Starter: 2 GB serverless storage, 5 indexes, 1 project, 1 GB egress per month, us-east-1 only

free_tier.stated: Starter: 2 GB serverless storage, 5 indexes, 1 project, 1 GB egress per month, us-east-1 only

per_object_cap.stated: 2 GB of index storage per organization; 100 namespaces per index

retention.stated: an index persists while the plan is active; no deletion clock is published for Starter

egress.terms: 1 GB per month on Starter. Builder is 10 GB; Standard includes 100 GB then USD 0.10/GB

record.interface_detail: a REST API for data and control planes; Python, Node and Java SDKs; the pinecone CLI
record.tooling: the Pinecone SDKs and CLI; no Postgres extension path
record.chaining: a free vector index that mostly matters for a workload too large for pgvector on a free Postgres, because pgvector is already available on both Neon and Supabase at no extra cost

limits.value: 2 GB of storage per organization, not per index
1 GB egress per month on Starter
5 indexes, 1 project per organization, us-east-1 only, and 100 namespaces per index
no connection limit is published for Starter; recorded as a gap

identity_cost.detail: email signup; no card on Starter

record.reliability_note: no suspension, throttle or data-loss event is recorded on the pages read
record.confidence_note: the pricing comparison table was read on 2026-10-22. The 1 GB monthly egress is on it. The project and index counts are on the pricing page too; they are recorded against it rather than against the object-limits page, which does not state them.

evidence.proved: Starter: storage up to 2 GB, egress up to 1 GB/month, indexes up to 5, namespaces per index 100; Builder USD 25 with 10 GB storage and 10 GB egress; Standard unlimited at USD 0.33/GB-month

record.notes: 2 GB is an organization-level cap and one project is the whole allowance, so there is no way to shard around it. 1 GB a month of egress is 33 MB a day, which a retrieval workload serving embeddings exceeds before the 2 GB of storage matters.

card.summary: Starter plan, labelled Free: 5,000,000 embedding tokens a month per model (llama-text-embed-v2, multilingual-e5-large, pinecone-sparse-english-v0, text-embed...

record.category: embedding and rerank API, monthly free token and request allowance on the Starter plan

free_tier.stated: Starter plan, labelled Free: 5,000,000 embedding tokens a month per model (llama-text-embed-v2, multilingual-e5-large, pinecone-sparse-english-v0, text-embedding-3-small and -large) and 500 rerank requests a month (bge-reranker-v2-m3, pinecone-rerank-v0)
free_tier.notes: the pricing page lists the three Pinecone-hosted embedding models and bge-reranker-v2-m3 only; the limits page also lists text-embedding-3 models and pinecone-rerank-v0 for Starter; gemini-embedding-2 and cohere-rerank-4-fast are not available on Starter

record.tooling: Pinecone SDKs and the REST inference endpoints embed and rerank; embeddings can be called without creating an index
record.chaining: the Starter plan's index allowance (5 indexes, 2 GB) is the same account's vector store, so embed, store and rerank stay under one key

limits.value: Starter: 5,000,000 embedding tokens per month per model and 500 rerank requests per month per rerank model; reaching either returns HTTP 429

Starter embedding throughput 250,000 passage tokens and 50,000 query tokens per minute per model (llama-text-embed-v2, multilingual-e5-large); bge-reranker-v2-m3 and pinecone-rerank-v0 60 requests per minute; inference requests 100 per second and 2,000 per minute per project

identity_cost.detail: a Pinecone account; the pricing page labels Starter 'Free' and its start link goes to the billing settings of the console; unverified: the sign-up form fields and whether a card is asked, because the console page returned no content to the page reader

record.reliability_note: no reliability event recorded; the Starter allowance is per month and resets
record.confidence_note: the monthly token and request allowances and the per-minute limits are quoted from the vendor's limits page and pricing page; the sign-up form fields are unverified. The two pages disagree on pinecone-rerank-v0 for Starter.
